full_judgment: 3. Defendant-respondents having entered appearance filed a written statement alleging, inter alia, that they took settlement of the suit schedule-I land from original landlords and they were in khas possession of the suit schedule-I land long before 1350 BS and paid rent of 1344 BS and 1345 BS and onward and started residing thereon constructing huts, latrines and ghat in the tank and the plaintiff had/has no right title and interest or possession in the suit land and that the names of the defendants have correctly been recorded in suit plot No. 185 during the last survey operation.
